entities.name: Maki Enjōji
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maki Enjōji  is a Japanese manga artist. Some of her works, such as Happy Marriage!? and Private Prince, have been published in French and German by Kazé and Tokyopop. Editorial Ivrea has released the Spanish version of Private Prince in 2011, which is still ongoing. Happy Marriage!? will be published in English under VIZ Media's Shojo Beat imprint on 6 August 2013.
